config._comment: Two axes. accuracy = worst element vs the known-good value; a broken kernel trips this. regression = this run's mean vs the committed baseline for the SAME backend; codegen drift trips this. GPU float legitimately differs from CPU, so accuracy is deliberately loose and regression is the real gate.

kernels.name: saxpy
kernels.reference: BLAS-1 saxpy, y := a*x + y. With x=1, y=3, a=2 every element is 5, exactly representable, so any deviation is the backend's fault not the maths'.
